cases.name: Vacuum pulse
cases.title: Point source in free space
cases.abstract: A magnetic line source radiates a 1.55 µm pulse into 2D vacuum; the CPML absorbs it at the edges.

cases.name: Strip waveguide
cases.title: 500 nm silicon strip in oxide
cases.abstract: An in-plane dipole inside a 0.5 µm Si core (n = 3.476) in SiO2 (n = 1.444): the guided TE mode carries the light along x.

cases.name: Sharp bend
cases.title: 90° corner in a silicon strip
cases.abstract: The same strip turned through a sharp 90° corner: part of the light follows the bend, the rest scatters into the oxide.

cases.name: Bragg mirror
cases.title: Eight Si layers in oxide
cases.abstract: A source in front of eight 110 nm silicon layers with a 370 nm period: much of the light reflects and interferes with itself.
